changes.effect: Adds the P07-P10 analytics/ML quartet (16 cards + 1 review gate) behind the trio bundles. Documented planning effort for P07-P10 sums to 202.5 h at range midpoints.

changes.title: AppleDouble sidecar cleanup after ExFAT metadata was accidentally staged
changes.reason: Nine '._*' AppleDouble sidecars were staged with the P07 kit directory and had to be removed in a dedicated commit. The workspace volume is ExFAT, so macOS regenerates these siblings continuously; PORTFOLIO_STATUS.md and DECISIONS.md #10 already record the same class of failure for P04 test discovery.

adds_tasks.hours_basis: solo author estimate for locating and unstaging nine sidecars; not measured

changes.effect: Inserts 0.25 h of unplanned corrective work between P07-02 and P07-03, matching the real commit order 2ff5f6e -> 3be4111 -> 48efbaa.

changes.title: New export_impl.py instead of modifying the kit's review_bundle.py
changes.reason: The bundles had to be implementation-inclusive. The kit tool portfolio-source-kit/tools/review_bundle.py is covered by the kit SHA256SUMS manifest, so modifying it would break kit integrity verification. A new script opencode-handoff/export_impl.py was written instead.

changes.effect: Adds a shared tool task in front of all three bundle tasks; preserves kit hash integrity.

changes.title: CV work deferred
changes.reason: PLAN.md scope update states 'CVs are deferred' so that all projects finish first. output/cv-pack-2026-10-06/ exists from earlier work but is not part of this release and receives no further tasks.
changes.effect: No CV task enters the release plan. Recorded so the deferral is visible rather than silent.

changes.title: Pre-bundle preflight gate added (P16-04 process fix)
changes.reason: Retrospective finding PF-1: the authorization of record drifted from the delivered work. PLAN.md's P04-P22 authorization was never committed, HEAD's PLAN.md still withholds P07-P22, and PORTFOLIO_STATUS.md / HANDOFF.md were last committed at f4996a8 and mention P07-P10 zero times while 17 commits delivered them. A machine-checkable preflight gate is added so a release cannot be declared ready while its planning record is stale or self-contradictory.

adds_tasks.title: Run preflight.py: planning-record freshness and authorization consistency
adds_tasks.hours_basis: solo author estimate for writing and running the checker; not measured

changes.effect: Adds one machine-checkable gate in front of the quartet review. Root-level adoption (running preflight.py before each commit at the repository root) is a RECOMMENDATION only; nothing outside release-plan/ was modified.
